facts: Terra is a public blockchain protocol deploying a suite of algorithmic decentralized stablecoins.
The Terra protocol is built on the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint Consensus.
Terraform Labs secured $150 million in commitments for its ecosystem from investors.
LUNA is Terra’s decentralized reserve asset where more demand for Terra stablecoins results in more value capture.
Matt Cantieri joined Terraform Labs as the General Manager of Anchor Protocol after leaving Microsoft’s M12.
